keyEvents.text: First Half begins.
Delay in match because of an injury Mitchell Weiser (Werder Bremen).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Substitution, Werder Bremen. Eren Dinkçi replaces Mitchell Weiser because of an injury.
Delay in match (Hoffenheim).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Delay in match because of an injury Ludovit Reis (Werder Bremen).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Delay in match (Hoffenheim).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
First Half ends, Werder Bremen 0, Hoffenheim 0.
Second Half begins Werder Bremen 0, Hoffenheim 0.
Goal! Werder Bremen 1, Hoffenheim 0. Niclas Füllkrug (Werder Bremen) left footed shot from the centre of the box to the top left corner. Assisted by Karl Hein.Goal confirmed following VAR Review.
Substitution, Hoffenheim. Tim Lemperle replaces Adam Hlozek.
Marco Friedl (Werder Bremen) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Substitution, Werder Bremen. Mick Schmetgens replaces Olivier Deman.
Substitution, Werder Bremen. Senne Lynen replaces Chuki.
Goal! Werder Bremen 2, Hoffenheim 0. Eren Dinkçi (Werder Bremen) right footed shot from the centre of the box to the top right corner. Assisted by Marco Grüll.
Substitution, Hoffenheim. Cajetan Lenz replaces Leon Avdullahu.
Substitution, Hoffenheim. Jykese Fields replaces Fisnik Asllani.
Substitution, Hoffenheim. Yasin Zor replaces Andrej Kramaric.
Substitution, Hoffenheim. Valentin Lässig replaces Mats Rots.
Substitution, Werder Bremen. Oskar Wójcik replaces Niclas Füllkrug.
Substitution, Werder Bremen. Dariusz Stalmach replaces Ludovit Reis.
Arthur (Werder Bremen) is shown the yellow card.
Youri Regeer (Werder Bremen) is shown the yellow card.
Second Half ends, Werder Bremen 2, Hoffenheim 0.
